items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: There was Al Robinson. And I think at that time... we all went to, uh, uh, we all went to, uh, Motown. Uh, no. We went to New York, uh, with these artists that Joe, you know, paid, paid away and all that kind of stuff.

ctx.x: I have it on my list. We missed all of that.

How'd you get involved with the Dixie Cups? Uh, Dixie Cups, uh, and they had my band, and, uh, Joe Jones heard the band, and he came by and said if I would do some things with him. You know, he had a couple of artists that he wanted to record if I would help him with it. Uh-huh. One of the artists was, uh, was the Dixie Cups. There was Al Robinson. And I think at that time, uh, uh, what is this boy named that did work, that's Fass Domino's, uh, brother-in-law. Uh, he did a, did something. And we all went to, uh,…
What did you have to, did you have to pull them together musically? I mean, did they have their songs? No, that's what I'm saying.
